name: Should I restore my space to its original design or remodel it after water damage?

mainEntity.name: Should I restore my space to its original design or remodel it after water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: A water-damage repair allows you to either restore what was originally there or roll the rebuild into a broader room remodel. If your bathroom or kitchen had outdated cabinetry, worn fixtures, or an awkward layout, repairing water-damaged subfloors and drywall provides an ideal opening to reconfigure the space. You can update plumbing lines, convert an unused tub into a walk-in shower, or install modern cabinets while the room is opened up.
acceptedAnswer.description: If your space was already outdated, water-damage reconstruction is an ideal time to upgrade layouts, modern fixtures, and cabinetry.
